newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 4c to 611c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 4c to 611c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market's eastern indicator fell 4.0 cents to 611 cents a kg clean at auctions in Sydney on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In merino fleece, the 19 micron indicator was 2.5 percent cheaper, leading a near-across-the-board decline.
Merino fleece of 20/22/24m were up to 1.0 percent cheaper, while 21m was 1.0 percent dearer.
In merino skirtings, 19m was 1.0 percent cheaper, with 20/21/22 microns up to 2.0 percent cheaper, WI said.
In crossbreds, 27m was 0.5 percent dearer but 28/29m were 0.5 percent cheaper and 30/31m 1.0 percent cheaper.
In cardings, locks were firm, with crutchings generally unchanged, WI said.
Japanese interests provided principal competition with good support from most sectors of the trade, WI said.
Of the 9,044 bales offered in Sydney, 13.7 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Wednesday in Sydney and Fremantle with about 21,000 bales on offer.
